adds.title: ILGA-Europe Rainbow ranking 2024 (and 2016 rating)
adds.summary: Russia scored 2% in the 2026 European LGBTI legal and policy ranking and maintains explicit bans/legal limitations that make legal gender recognition practically impossible.

adds.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling designating 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist - November 2023
adds.summary: On 30 November 2023 the Supreme Court of Russia designated the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist and banned it throughout Russia including Khakassia, making organizing, participation, funding, public display of LGBT symbols including trans-related expression, and advocacy punishable as extremist activity with fines, administrative detention and imprisonment.
